front.title: Authorization Evidence and Audit Trail for OAuth 2.0 Access Tokens

abstract.t: This specification defines an authorization details type for carrying authorization evidence in OAuth 2.0 access tokens, using the enriched response mechanism of Rich Authorization Requests. When an Authorization Server records an approval decision, it enriches the authorization details with cryptographic proof of the decision and of the structured disclosure on which the decision was based. Evidence is recorded for approved, narrowed, and declined decisions, supporting accountability, compliance, and dispute resolution in scenarios where autonomous agents act on behalf of users. An approval record that cannot be ended is not an accountable record, so this specification defines the withdrawal mechanism alongside the evidence itself. Withdrawal is one of the four ways a governing authorization ends, alongside completion, termination, and expiry.
